hooks.name: Task gate: make check must pass
hooks.description: Runs after a spec task. Kiro has no hook that blocks a checkbox, so a non-zero exit sends the failures to the agent, which must reopen the task. Closest supported trigger to 'cannot be marked done'.

hooks.name: Task gate: reopen on failure
hooks.description: Agent-side half of the gate: states the rule before the task begins.

action.prompt: Rule from .kiro/steering/testing.md: this task may only be marked done when `uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`, `uv run mypy` and `make scripts` all pass. If any fail after your work, leave the checkbox unticked and fix or report the failure.
